node.title: Re^2: Shrink Images and PDFs
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Thanks very much for the feedback, I'm glad to hear it's helpful. As for the [doc://@INC] issue, my guess would be that your [mod://local::lib] configuration is set in your ~/.bashrc or ~/.profile, and that doesn't get run for these scripts. So thank you for providing a workaround for anyone who might run into the same issue.
